basic_details.offering_entity: Leiden University (Faculty of Science & Leiden Institute of Advanced Computer Science - LIACS)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Leiden University (Leiden and The Hague Campuses, Netherlands)
basic_details.major_restrictions: All English-taught Master of Science programmes, including Computer Science (Data Science, Advanced Computing and Systems, Artificial Intelligence), ICT in Business and the Public Sector, and Media Technology.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~50 to 70 LExS awards distributed across all Leiden University faculties annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open global merit competition; typically 2 to 5 high-achieving Pakistani graduates selected annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2 years (standard duration of Master's programme; 120 ECTS credits), subject to satisfactory progress

nationality_requirements: Non-EEA/non-EU international students liable for non-EU tuition fees
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related STEM discipline from an HEC-recognized university with outstanding academic record (ranked within top 10% of graduating cohort; minimum 82% aggregate or CGPA 3.50 / 4.00).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Leiden University evaluates international degrees against Dutch WO Bachelor level (comparable to 8.0+ on Dutch 10-point scale).
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Rigorous undergraduate training in algorithms, discrete mathematics, computer architecture, databases, and software engineering.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Final-year undergraduate students can apply conditionally; degree completion certificate required before August.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not mandatory; technical research projects and academic publications significantly strengthen the application.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic min 6.5 (all bands 6.0+) or TOEFL iBT min 90 (components 20+). Medium of Instruction letters not accepted for degrees from Pakistan.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; instruction and research conducted entirely in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: LExS is awarded across three tiers: Tier 1 covers full tuition + EUR 15,000 living allowance; Tier 2 covers full tuition; Tier 3 covers partial tuition (EUR 10,000).
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot be combined with other full Dutch scholarships (e.g. NL Scholarship).

tuition_fee.details: Full tuition waiver covering non-EU international graduate tuition (~EUR 19,600 to 21,300 / year value; ~PKR 6,100,000 to 6,600,000 / year).

admission_application_fee.details: Leiden University non-refundable application fee of EUR 100 paid online via uSis portal.

accommodation.details: Leiden Housing Office assists international students with DUWO student accommodations in Leiden and The Hague; single student rooms average EUR 450 to 750/month.

monthly_stipend.details: Tier 1 LExS recipients receive an annual living allowance of EUR 15,000 / year (~EUR 1,250 / month; ~PKR 387,500 / month). Tier 2 and Tier 3 winners cover living expenses through family funds or NL Scholarship supplements.

airfare.details: International travel between Pakistan and Amsterdam Schiphol Airport (AMS) is self-funded.

visa_fee.details: Dutch residence permit (VVR) and entry visa (MVV) fee of EUR 228 paid to IND via Leiden University visa services.

health_insurance.details: International student health insurance (e.g. Aon Student Insurance or OOM, ~EUR 45 to 60/month; ~EUR 600/year) required for residence in the Netherlands.

food_allowance.details: Food and living expenses covered comfortably by the EUR 15,000/year living allowance.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to Leiden University Library resources, digital journals, compute servers, and LIACS laboratories.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: LIACS faculty travel grants available for Master's thesis students presenting papers at academic conferences.
research_funding_conference_grant.amount: Up to EUR 1,000 per conference presentation

travel_transit_allowance.details: NS train and regional public transit fares paid by student; bike commuting is standard across Leiden.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single historic Dutch research university: Leiden University (Leiden / The Hague, Netherlands)
participating_institutions: Leiden Institute of Advanced Computer Science (LIACS)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 100 global university (QS World #141, THE World #77); oldest university in the Netherlands (founded 1575) and leading research center in algorithms, data science, and AI.
available_majors: MSc in Computer Science: Artificial Intelligence
MSc in Computer Science: Data Science
MSc in Computer Science: Advanced Computing and Systems
MSc in Computer Science: Foundations of Computing
MSc in ICT in Business and the Public Sector
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: 4-year BS in CS/STEM with 3.5+ GPA, motivation letter, CV, 2 recommendation letters, and IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL 90+. LExS motivation letter required.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Data Science and AI specializations attract highest applicant volume; Advanced Computing and Systems, ICT in Business, and Foundations offer slightly higher admit rates.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: In the LExS application section of uSis, upload a dedicated 500-word LExS motivation letter specifically articulating academic excellence and why you deserve this prestigious award.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Studielink & Leiden University uSis Application Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register first on Studielink.nl to submit study enrolment, then receive login credentials for the Leiden uSis application portal, upload documents, and apply for LExS.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1 (October - January): Register on Studielink.nl and submit study enrolment for Leiden Master's programme.
Step 2 (In uSis portal): Complete application profile and upload degree certificates, transcripts, CV, and motivation letter.
Step 3 (Scholarship section): In the scholarship section of the uSis application, indicate that you wish to apply for the LExS.
Step 4 (LExS motivation letter): Upload a separate LExS motivation letter (max 500 words) outlining your academic excellence.
Step 5 (By 1 February): Pay EUR 100 application fee and submit application before strict LExS deadline.
Step 6 (March - April): Faculty selection committee reviews dossiers and ranks LExS candidates.
Step 7 (Late April - Early May): Official admission decision and LExS award notification released.
Step 8 (May - June): Accept scholarship offer, submit financial guarantee (if applicable), and initiate Dutch MVV visa process.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated application: LExS application is submitted directly within the uSis online admissions portal simultaneously with the master's application.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Two academic recommendation letters uploaded directly by applicant or submitted via referee email in uSis.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Program motivation letter plus separate LExS motivation letter (max 500 words) answering: (1) Academic achievements and class ranking, (2) Relevance of target master's to future goals, (3) Why you merit an excellence scholarship.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Not required at Master's level; concise research interests outline integrated into motivation letter.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: 1 to 2 page academic CV detailing education, technical competencies, programming skills, capstone projects, and academic honors.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: No interviews; decisions are based purely on academic evaluation of the submitted dossier.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (6.5+) or TOEFL iBT (90+). GRE is NOT required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Certified scans uploaded with application; official degree certificates verified upon arrival.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translations required for all non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% digital submission via Studielink and Leiden uSis portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Scanned color copy of original Bachelor's degree certificate and official English translation.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani applicants submit 4-year BS degree certificate; HEC attestation recommended.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete consolidated semester transcripts detailing all completed course units, grades, and grading scale.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure transcript clearly states credit hours and grading scale (CGPA out of 4.0).

required_documents_checklist.specification: Max 500-word essay explaining academic excellence, ranking within graduating class, and alignment with Leiden.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Provide proof of class rank or percentile if available from your Pakistani university registrar.

required_documents_checklist.specification: 1-2 page essay articulating academic background, technical interests, and motivation for the specific master's track.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlight final-year project (FYP) and technical tools used.

required_documents_checklist.specification: 1 to 2 page CV detailing academic background, programming proficiencies, capstone projects, and distinctions.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Clearly link GitHub repositories, hackathons, and published work.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Two academic reference letters from university professors assessing analytical and intellectual capacity.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Referees must submit from institutional email addresses (.edu.pk).

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official IELTS Academic TRF (6.5+) or TOEFL iBT score report (90+).
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be valid through application deadline; MOI letters strictly not accepted.

important_dates_timeline.application_deadline: 1 February 2026 (Strict LExS deadline for September intake)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Strict 1 February deadline for September intake. Applicants who miss this deadline cannot be considered for LExS.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 60% (Academic excellence, CGPA, grades in mathematics and core computing coursework, university prestige)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Quality of LExS motivation letter and program SOP)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Faculty of Science LExS Selection Committee and LIACS Admissions Board.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Competitive merit ranking: Faculty committees evaluate candidates primarily on academic performance (top 10% cutoff) and quality of motivation letter. Top candidates are awarded Tier 1 or Tier 2 LExS packages.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: 2,500+ international applicants across Leiden University Master's programmes
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~50 to 70 LExS awards across all tiers university-wide
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~2% to 3% among qualified Pakistani STEM applicants
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Undergraduate degree in CS/SE from premier university (FAST, NUST, LUMS, GIKI, UET), top 5% standing, outstanding algorithm grades, compelling LExS essay, IELTS 7.5+.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of NUST, FAST-NUCES, LUMS, and GIKI.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: China, India, United States, Pakistan, Indonesia, Brazil, Turkey

fake_websites_and_scams: Commercial education recruiters charging fees claiming guaranteed admission or scholarships at Leiden. Admissions are handled strictly via Studielink and uSis.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Leiden application fee is EUR 100 paid online via uSis. Never pay fees to external agents.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Leiden University does not work with education recruitment agents. Plagiarized statements result in immediate rejection.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Flight ticket from Pakistan to Amsterdam: ~PKR 250,000 to 380,000.
First month's rent and housing deposit in Leiden/The Hague: ~EUR 1,200 (~PKR 372,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: All LExS winners receive a full living allowance. (FACT: LExS has multiple tiers; only top Tier 1 winners receive the EUR 15,000 living allowance, while Tier 2 covers tuition only).
CLAIM: You can apply for LExS after being admitted. (FACT: LExS application MUST be indicated and submitted by the 1 February deadline simultaneously with admission).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some online forums report that the general application deadline is 1 April. While general non-visa applications close later, the strict LExS scholarship deadline is ALWAYS 1 February.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain satisfactory academic performance and complete at least 60 ECTS credits during Year 1 to renew the scholarship for Year 2.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical enrollment at Leiden University.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress reviews conducted by the Faculty of Science.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Dutch student visa permits part-time work of up to 16 hours per week (work permit required from employer) or full-time during summer months.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None. International graduates qualify for the Dutch 1-year Orientation Year visa (Zoekjaar) to seek employment or launch a startup.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: No clawback of previously awarded funds; academic failure results in cancellation of scholarship for Year 2.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Scholarship is granted for the nominal 2-year duration (120 ECTS) and cannot be extended.
